description: This file defines the I18NService class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for internationalization tasks such as managing language translations, caching translation messages, and interfacing with translation data access objects (DAOs). It includes methods for retrieving and caching translation data, generating cache keys, handling language resources, and translating strings within the application.

classes.name: I18NService
classes.description: A service class managing internationalization including translation retrieval, caching, and language resource management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getI18NDao
methods.description: Returns the data access object for internationalization messages, initializing it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: addLanguage
methods.description: Tracks loaded language resources to prevent duplicates, associating language code with resource type.

methods.name: isLanguageLoaded
methods.description: Checks whether a specific language resource type has already been loaded.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Creates a cache key prefix based on language code.

methods.name: generateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for translation messages for a specific language.

methods.name: generateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for key-target translation array.

methods.name: generateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for source-target translation array.

methods.name: generateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for ETag associated with language translations.

methods.name: getTranslationCollection
methods.description: Fetches all translation messages for a language from DAO and organizes them into a TranslationCollection.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonStringAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves translation messages as JSON string, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates an ETag for a language's translation messages, stored in cache.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Provides translation messages as a JSON string for a given language, ensuring cache validation.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Returns an array of key-target translation pairs for a language.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Returns an array of source-target translation pairs for a language.

methods.name: cleanAndRefetchIfCacheNotHit
methods.description: Ensures cache is refreshed if not hit, re-fetching translation data.

methods.name: getETagByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves or generates an ETag for the translation messages of a specific language.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Symfony Translator instance configured with default settings.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language locale for the Translator.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a key into the target language, loading resources if necessary.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source language string into the target language.

methods.name: cleanCacheByLangCode
methods.description: Clears all cached translation data for a given language code.
